products.name: Free
products.outcome: Read daily intel, browse manufacturers/projects/tenders/events, post an RFQ, use selected tools and learning.

products.name: Learning
products.outcome: Learn: full pathways, practice, progress, 3D learning, Test Bay, capstones, completion records.

products.name: Professional
products.outcome: Work: Learning plus professional engineering utility — costing workbench, specification builder, bid evaluation, DGA workspace, professional exports.

products.name: Team
products.outcome: A team on one plan with organization management, members, individual progress, assigned pathways and a shared workspace.

products.name: Listed
products.outcome: A factual public listing — company, country, researched categories, official website, sourced capability.
products.neutrality: No endorsement. Listed is a census listing, not a recommendation.

products.name: Verified Manufacturer
products.outcome: Verified company contact, enhanced profile, logo/media, product info, brochure, contact CTA, RFQ response eligibility, basic analytics, website backlink where organically relevant, featured pin on the Industry Map.
products.neutrality: VERIFIED MANUFACTURER means the organization/contact/profile completed TransformerPath's defined verification process. It does NOT mean product certified, quality certified, approved supplier, or technically superior.

products.name: Supplier Pro
products.outcome: Everything in Verified plus advanced analytics, commercial profile tools, RFQ workflow, market watchlists, Intel Pro entitlement, monthly performance report, promotional inventory (including a featured Industry Map pin), advanced opportunity alerts.
products.neutrality: Promotional placement is explicitly FEATURED or SPONSORED. Pro never buys organic technical ranking.

products.name: Intel Free
products.outcome: Daily intel, factual summaries, projects, tenders, basic company activity, limited follows and alerts.

products.name: Intel Pro
products.outcome: Advanced project/tender filters, award history, factory expansions, company timelines, saved searches, watchlists, alerts, country dashboards, historical archive, monthly brief, exports when ready.
products.neutrality: Intel Pro adds monitoring/filtering/decision value — it never paywalls the factual headline. Factual Intel stays public.

products.name: Intel Team
products.outcome: Organization, members, shared watchlists, shared saved searches, team alerts, exports, shared reports.

products.name: Enterprise Intelligence
products.outcome: Multi-user access, advanced exports, custom market monitoring, custom reports, research requests, bespoke briefings, company/project tracking.

products.name: Featured Event
products.outcome: Prominent, clearly-labelled placement, logo/banner, enhanced event page, registration CTA, sponsor/exhibitor links, analytics.
products.neutrality: FEATURED is promotional placement, clearly labelled. It is not an editorial recommendation.

products.name: Featured Exhibitor
products.outcome: FEATURED label, logo, booth number, products, brochure, manufacturer profile, meeting CTA, event analytics.
products.neutrality: FEATURED is promotional placement. It never implies an editorial recommendation.

products.name: Hosted Webinar
products.outcome: Event page, registration, promotion, hosting, recording where supported, post-event replay, sponsor identification. Attendee reporting subject to privacy/consent.

products.name: Sponsorship
products.outcome: Daily Intel sponsor, event spotlight, category sponsor, market sponsor, newsletter sponsor, annual knowledge partner. Every paid placement is visibly SPONSORED or FEATURED.
products.neutrality: Every paid placement is visibly SPONSORED or FEATURED. We never sell editorial conclusions.
